title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00100 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling

sections.text: Run and landed out on MST ring, engaged as per ge instructions
Made up TDS, 75t overpull to pull MST seal.
POOH with ret tool
Removed control lines, rigged down spooler, layed out retrieval tool.
Serviced drilling equipment
Performed pre-job meeting/brief/debrief
Picked up cutter BHA and inspect same
Picked up sgl and RIH with cutter from 13m to 130m.
Made up TDS and filled string
Took parameters at 330 LPM, 29 bar, 400 LPM, 51 bar, up WT 74t, DW WT 71t,, free rot TQ 5 KNM, cut CSG as per well bore instructions at 130m
Pumped out of hole from 130m to 15m due to not enough weight below spear
Engaged fish with the spear, POOH, CSG hanger on surface, inspected same
TBT for rigging up CSG handling equipment
R/u handling equipment
TBT prior to pulling 10 3/4 tie back
Attempted to break first connection. No go. Torque too high to break. Remove slip guides for adjustable sub assy to pass and pull up to next connection
POOH with 10 3/4 tie back to surface. Length of off cut 6. 85m
TBT for rigging down casing equipment
R/d casing equipment. Install bx4 elevators
TBT for running in hole with ge jetting sub and torque tool
Picked up jetting sub with torque tool and XO 6 5/8 to 5 ½ FH made up and run in hole laying out first single 5 ½ DP for space out. Checking torque on all connections
Washed down from 134m 1500lts min 23 bar increasing to 33 bar stopped pumps and tag tie back assy 140m
Released tie back w/ 3 turns. Tie back broke at 25 KNM
POOH and pick up single 5 ½ DP back into string and lay out BHA to canteliver
Picked up spear assy from canteliver and RIH from surface to 143m off point)

Tagged 143. 48m bit depth with 3t, picked string up to neutral weight and turn string 4 turns LH to unscrew remaining threads on adaptor. Started mud pumps and pressured up to maintain minimum 15 bar. 1050lts/ min 16 bar, picked up string to 140m and increased pump rate to maintain minimum 15 bar pressure in string, 1170lts/ min 16 bar, picked up to 139m and increase pump rate to maintain minimum 15bar pressure 1500lts/ min 20bar
Engaged spear and POOH. Fish not on spear
Ge and wellbore inspected tools. Wellbore tool found to be in release position due to LH turns in string to release well head adapter. Reset tool
RIH with spear assy. And engaged spear, 4t overpull observed
POOH with spear assy. Fish not on spear.
Inspected tool and reset. L/o spear assy
P/u assy with different type of spear spear w/ grapple), inspected and doped
Drill. Table top talked gas procedure and experience transfer.
TBT prior to running spear
RIH from RKB to 130m, engaged fish and pulled free with 30t overpull. Pulled to surface, secured and disengaged fish
Layed out fish to deck, inspect and layed out spear
Cleaned and cleared rig floor of excess equipment
TBT for picking up and running guns
M/u gun BHA, changed dies in iron roughneck for some of connections
RIH from RKB t0 130m, closed BOP and circulated with 200 LPM, 2 bar. To confirm line up
